description: Ask the vehicle to start charging (`evc/charge`). Verified against a plugged-in vehicle: evStatus.batteryCharge goes true within ~30-60s. Requires the car to be plugged in — on an unplugged car Kia still accepts the request and nothing happens. Confirm with kia_vehicle_status rather than trusting the success status. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call makes NO network call and returns a preview plus a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

chargeRatio.description: Charge up to this percentage, 10–100. Defaults to 100.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

vinKey.description: Vehicle key (the `vehicleKey` from the vehicle-list tool). Not the VIN.

name: kia_start_charge
